# Story locations

Original generated painted environments, optimized to WebP: 1536×1024 landscapes and a 1024×1536 invitation-veranda portrait. These are artistic impressions, not verified layouts or photographs of Vivenza.

| Asset                 | Story action                                            |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| courtyard.webp        | Friends meet at home and exchange the invitation        |
| invitation-veranda.webp / invitation-veranda-mobile.webp | Lantern-lit veranda where she shares the invitation; landscape and portrait compositions |
| pickup.webp           | Their car collects them outside the home                |
| drive-navratri.webp            | A lantern-lit road with Navratri celebrants along the sides, viewed through the windscreen  |
| selfie-corner.webp    | Floral photo alcove inside the venue                    |
| shrine-courtyard.webp | Aarti in a devotional courtyard before the Garba circle |

The same teal evening sky, amber lantern light, carved Gujarati architecture and marigold decoration connect the locations. Each leaves clear foreground space for the original characters. The invitation veranda has a separately composed portrait asset so its arch and lanterns remain visible on mobile. Other scenes use the central composition; the driving zoom is anchored at the road vanishing point. Keep each image mapped to its story action when replacing artwork.
